title: Paloma Business Fee Schedule Footnote: Payout Fee Offset on Early Termination
content:
Payout fees and SWIFT payout fees taken from a Paloma Business balance in the six months before the day a downgrade is scheduled, counted from the day after the same calendar day six months earlier up to and including that day, decide a fee offset on that downgrade's early termination charge.

### Offset bands

| Payout fees and SWIFT payout fees in the window | Fee offset |
|---|---|
| 35.00 USD or more | 50 percent of that total |
| 20.00 USD up to 34.99 USD | 25 percent of that total |
| Below 20.00 USD | Not offset |

As a clause: fees totalling 35.00 USD or more are offset at 50 percent of that total; fees totalling 20.00 USD up to 34.99 USD are offset at 25 percent of that total; smaller totals are not offset; the fee offset is rounded half up to the cent.

The fee offset is a fixed amount in US dollars deducted from the early termination charge once the gross termination charge has been reduced by its percentage discounts, if any, and rounded half up to the cent; the charge after the deduction is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent.

### Worked figures (hypothetical fee totals)

| Fees in the window | Offset |
|---|---|
| 41.86 USD | 50 percent: 20.93 USD |
| 35.00 USD | 50 percent: 17.50 USD |
| 34.99 USD | 25 percent: 8.7475, rounded half up to 8.75 USD |
| 27.45 USD | 25 percent: 6.8625, rounded half up to 6.86 USD |
| 19.99 USD | Not offset |

Only fees charged as payout fees or SWIFT payout fees count; cancellation, return, deposit and withdrawal fees do not.
